title: Serve orders with net/http
summary: Build a net/http handler that reads and creates orders through an injected store, with strict JSON validation and request-context propagation.
objectives: Expose order reads and writes through a net/http handler backed by an injected Store.
Validate POST payloads strictly and map failures to stable JSON error bodies.
Propagate the request context to every store call.
constraints: Keep the Order and Store types and the NewHandler(store Store) http.Handler signature.
Use http.ServeMux routing; unknown paths keep the mux default 404 and unsupported methods the mux default 405.
Trim the POST id before validation and storage.
Reject a POST body that is malformed or contains more than one JSON value.
Set Content-Type application/json on every JSON response.

examples.input: GET /orders/A-1 with store.Get returning Order{ID: "A-1", TotalCents: 1250}, true, nil
examples.explanation: A found order is returned as JSON.
A missing order is a client-visible 404.
The id is trimmed once, then validated and stored.

public.name: Read an order
public.description: A stored order is returned as JSON; an unknown id is not found.

public.name: Create an order
public.description: A valid POST trims the id, stores once, and reports the new location.
